svg.title: ANSIL - README rumble
svg.desc: Ansil / ClashLex: a margin duel. A figure climbs out of a broken word and ascends the bio lines to meet a swordsman on the heading rule. Their duel cuts the rule and the words, a Chopper cameo interrupts the tug-of-war, a vertical clone pincer is broken, and a love charm turns into the trigger for Bankai: Margin Storm. The ink field, spectral katana and blade storm bury the challenger, who digs out with a pickaxe as the page rebuilds.
